text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lunch break. In the central courtyard,
I heard a lively commotion—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, Spe-chan is up next!!
I am definitely, definitely not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best, Urara-chan!
I'm not gonna lose either~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, both runners~ Take your marks, please~
Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It seems they're having an arm-wrestling match.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan!
You can give up now, you know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look who's talking, Spe-chan!
Your arms are shaking like crazy, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara kept up her confident front,
but her arm was pushed right to the brink—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I definitely won't lose!
I'll never give u—WHOAAA?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Aww, so close! I lost again!
What do I gotta do to win, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
How do you win at arm wrestling?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! You're totally right!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"It's an encouragement spell, Trainer!
Fulcrum, effort, load!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! Let's do one more round, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Nnn-gh, then I'll use my magic spell
for trying hard too—Carrot Hamburg Steak!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I win, tonight's dinner is carrot steak!
I'm totally gonna eat carrot steeeaaak!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fulcrum, effort, load!
Fulcrum! Effort! Here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, she lost the match, but—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that incantation gave me super strength!
Fulcrum, effort, load point!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have taken a liking to the spell
and was in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I see!
In other words, it's just like a race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If I try super hard, I can definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, Spe-chan, let's go one more round!
I'm definitely gonna win this time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
All right, I'm gonna get pumped up too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, she lost the match, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To think Urara would push back from there~
That was a real surprise.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was panicking too!
Urara-chan, let's race again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Wasn't that amazing?
Next time I definitely won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had given it her all,
and looked thoroughly satisfied.
